recipe_provenance.reuse: Same PyMeshLab operations; generic explicit region selection and additional exported-STL checks. Historical source unchanged.

stage_contract.selection: Triangle-centroid union of explicitly selected physical-contact centres, explicit LPS/mm guides, and declared AABBs. No subject coordinates.
checks: Every operation reopens and checks its exported STL; topology, watertightness, positive volume and self intersections.
Native checksurfdist plus bidirectional sampled distance to preceding exported surface.
Final bidirectional sampled distance and volume relative to original source exterior.
Y/Z protrusion against corrected-skin bounds when artificial cylinders are present; also retained for actual FEM boundary.
Physical inventory/groups/nominal areas preserved; raw, original projected, source projected and current projected centres remain distinct.
Source-contact file copied byte-for-byte; source/output surface SHA and contact projection shifts recorded.
stage_contract.source_integrity: New helper and historical recipe source SHA are included in preparation source snapshots.
limitations: No strict wall-clock or peak-memory bound for the native remesher; face/vertex limits are checked at operation boundaries.
Regional selection is based on triangle centroids, not a proof of complete contact or sensitivity-volume coverage.
Successful surface QC does not establish FEM convergence or anatomical validity.

verification.scope: Historical tiny-remesh checks; current aggregate 66-test, MATLAB CEM and tiny TetGen status is in ct_fem_preparation_scope.json.

intended_path: Validate generic artifact SHA, LPS/mm geometry and physical inventory; bind current FEM mesh and boundary IDs.
Record projection onto actual FEM boundary separately from raw and remeshed-surface coordinates.
For the first supported version, require one common nominal area and explicit positive common z_contact in ohm*m^2 with provenance; reject absent values or heterogeneous unsupported parameters.
Build ALL physically present patches together, using trkg4_local_patch_context and trkg4_local_exact_patches (canonical full-builder fallback).

Preserve canonical node disjointness and induced-face area; combine disjoint physical patches into declared equipotential groups. Unconnected patches remain separate floating CEM groups with zero external current.
Use trkg4_scale_fmdl_to_si with explicit mm/scale_nodes_to_si=true, then trkg4_cem_contact_matrix. Preserve ordered drive and measurement group pairs.
Use existing EIDORS/material assembly and trkg4_lateral_cem_response for numerical checks; no Python copy of CEM or FEM physics.
After live post, add a new generic worker/profile through run_pipeline with explicit generic schema and cache identity; do not relabel the Georg worker as generic.

primary_interfaces.constraint: Common scalar target area, collective ownership over all centres, canonical fallback.
Node disjointness and induced-face area are physical patch invariants; separate calls for unequal areas cannot substitute for the collective builder.
Geometry converted to metres; require explicit mm units and model name. Contact impedance remains in SI.
Canonical contact surface matrix, not a complete FEM solve.
Existing solve/readout/derivative kernel; no second implementation.
Reusable boundary-map validation; physical contact-master identity must remain separate from pose/geometry reference.
Georg/12-contact assembly cannot be treated as a generic interface.
Georg configuration, 100kHz and experiment-specific observations/pose. Requires a separate schema adapter/worker after post.
Reuse existing P1/EIDORS material assembly and rule identities; keep frequency/material provenance explicit.

still_required_after_post: Canonical patch QC on actual FEM mesh: induced areas, centroid offsets, spatial extent, connectedness, nonempty patches and no shared physical nodes, with declared tolerances.
Synthetic grouped/floating layouts, drive/readout sign ordering and SI-scaling tests; agreement with canonical builder/EIDORS.
Exact patch-face inheritance and distinct contact/pose masters; direct-contact comparison on the same bulk mesh/materials.
Reciprocity, system residual, derivative checks and the separate inherited/remapped controls.
New run_pipeline routing and prepared-operator schema/cache checks after frozen post is complete.

communication_provenance.restart_status_origin: agent message in conversation, not human-author confirmation
